title: Understanding ROC Curves
text: ROC curves plot the true positive rate against the false positive rate. A perfect classifier will have a curve that goes straight up the y-axis and then across the top, indicating a true positive rate of $$1$$ with a false positive rate of $$0$$.

title: Interpreting ROC A
text: ROC A shows a perfect classifier. It goes straight up to $$1$$ on the y-axis and then across, indicating it perfectly separates the classes.

title: Interpreting ROC B
text: ROC B is a diagonal line from $$(0,0)$$ to $$(1,1)$$, which indicates a random classifier. It performs no better than random guessing.

title: Interpreting ROC C
text: ROC C shows a curve that goes along the x-axis and then up, indicating a classifier that predicts all negatives until the threshold is very high.
